title: Experiments in News Bias Detection with Pre-Trained Neural Transformers

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating language models (GPT-3.5, GPT-4, Llama2) on sentence-level bias detection using the Media Bias Identification Corpus (MBIC), analyzing specific sub-types like linguistic bias, text-level context bias, and reporting-level context bias.
Prompting LLMs to classify sentences from news articles into bias sub-categories, identifying political bias, and evaluating the accuracy of these classifications via manual human verification.

Prompting LLMs to classify sentences from news articles into bias sub-categories, identifying gender bias (e.g., traditional gender roles or anti-transgender framing), and evaluating the accuracy via human annotation.
Prompting LLMs to classify sentences from news articles into bias sub-categories, identifying racial bias, and evaluating the classification accuracy via human annotation.
